label: An amniote life-history database to perform comparative analyses with birds, mammals, and reptiles (Amniote_Database_Aug_2015.csv)
bibliographic_citation: Myhrvold NP, Baldridge E, Chan B, Sivam D, Freeman DL, Ernest SKM (2015) An amniote life-history database to perform comparative analyses with birds, mammals, and reptiles. Ecology 96:3109.
license: Ecological Archives data paper; free for non-commercial use with citation
measurement_technique: Literature-compiled life-history traits (maturity, clutch/litter size, body mass, longevity, gestation/incubation, egg mass) for birds, mammals and reptiles.
role: clutch/litter size, maturity, longevity and body mass for the listed amniote taxa (rows matched on genus + species, genus, or family)
